summary: In-place string range shift helper. Given a pointer to a string buffer (this), a destination index a2 and a source index a3, copies the substring from a3 through the terminator leftward by (a3 - a2), overwriting the range [a2, a3). Returns 0 on success and -1 when the buffer is null while a shift is requested, when a2 is negative, or when a3 exceeds the string length.

operations.description: Guard on the buffer pointer stored in this: the shift body runs only when the buffer is non-null.
Compute the length of the current buffer contents (strlen) into v5.
Return -1 when destination index a2 is negative.
Return -1 when source index a3 exceeds the computed string length v5.
Shift the trailing substring left: for each cursor v6 from a3 through the terminator index v5, copy the character at index v6 to index v6 - (a3 - a2), then advance v6.
Return 0 on success; return -1 from the null-buffer branch when either a2 or a3 is non-zero (a shift was requested on a null buffer).
